svg.title: SDLC Phases Mind Map
svg.desc: Mind map of all 7 SDLC phases with their key outputs, sub-topics, and SDLC models, based on the Gate Smashers lecture.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me a complete note on Software Development Life Cycle SDLC')
sendPrompt('Who are the two entities in SDLC and what are their roles?')
sendPrompt('Explain the Planning phase of SDLC with real life example')
sendPrompt('How do service providers submit quotations in the planning phase?')
sendPrompt('What types of communication happen in the planning phase?')
sendPrompt('Explain the Defining and Analysis phase of SDLC')
sendPrompt('How is COCOMO and function points used in the analysis phase?')
sendPrompt('What is the SRS document and why is it critical?')
sendPrompt('What happens when customers change requirements after the SRS is signed?')
sendPrompt('Explain the Designing phase of SDLC with DFD UML coupling cohesion')
sendPrompt('What are DFD and UML diagrams used for in software design?')
sendPrompt('Explain coupling and cohesion in software design')
sendPrompt('Explain the Implementation and coding phase of SDLC')
sendPrompt('What decisions are made about tech stack during implementation?')
sendPrompt('Explain all types of testing in SDLC: unit, integration, system, white-box, black-box')
sendPrompt('What is the difference between unit, integration, system, alpha and beta testing?')
sendPrompt('What is white-box vs black-box testing?')
sendPrompt('Explain the Deployment phase of SDLC')
sendPrompt('Explain the Maintenance phase of SDLC and how it is charged')
sendPrompt('What does technical support in the maintenance phase include?')
sendPrompt('How are post-warranty maintenance charges structured?')
sendPrompt('What are the different SDLC models: Waterfall, Agile, Spiral, RAD, V-model, Prototype?')
sendPrompt('Compare Waterfall, Spiral, Prototype, RAD, V-model and Agile')
